messages.author: e6c87266ffc5f0f2
messages.subject: strange ggsave error
parts:
Hi.

This gives no error:

i<-1
tmp[[i]]$plot
tmp[[i]]$filename

But this fails:

> i <- 1
> ggsave(filename=tmp[[i]]$filename,plot=tmp[[i]]$plot,width=width,height=height)
Error in get(as.character(FUN), mode = "function", envir = envir) :
object 'sh' of mode 'function' was not found

Any ideas?

Thanks.

messages.author: 27405c4b711a1080
messages.subject: Re: strange ggsave error
parts:
I'm pretty sure that filename needs to be a string and in ""'s. 

Does:
ggsave(filename=paste(tmp[[i]]$filename), plot=tmp[[i]]$plot, width=width, height=height)

Does your filename include the extension? (.png, .jpg, .pdf)

Does tmp[[i]]$plot actually plot your plot?

Brandon
